description: The pie chart represents the distribution of content types in the DODa dataset, categorized into six distinct groups. The categories include 'Moroccan Names' (orange), 'Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy)' (purple), 'Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives)' (orange), 'Translated Sentences' (yellow), 'Extra + Augmented Data' (blue), and 'Pending Translations' (green). The largest category is 'Pending Translations,' with approximately 50,000 entries, followed by 'Translated Sentences,' which has slightly fewer entries at 45,387. 'Extra + Augmented Data' is the third-largest category, with 30,000 entries. The smallest category is 'Semantic Categories,' which contains fewer than 1,000 entries. Notably, the chart indicates a steady increase in the proportion of 'Translated Sentences' compared to other categories, suggesting a focus on translation efforts in the dataset. The legend on the right provides a clear color-coded guide to the categories represented.
